images.name: Transurban Chesapeake
images.description: Transurban Chesapeake LLC is the concession platform that owns the entities operating the 495, 95 and 395 Express Lanes in Northern Virginia, including the Fredericksburg Extension and 495 NEXT. It develops, finances, operates and maintains dynamically priced express lanes serving motorists, high-occupancy vehicles, buses and permitted commercial traffic in partnership with VDOT. At June 30, 2026, Transurban reported 50% ownership, AustralianSuper 25%, CPP Investments 15% and UniSuper 10%; only AustralianSuper and CPP Investments are tracked infrastructure-manager owners here. The 495 concession covered 26.5 kilometres and the 95/395/FredEx concession 79 kilometres, each running through December 2087. No platform sale, secondary transfer or signed pending exit was identified through August 18, 2026. Chesapeake Partnership and Chesapeake toll road network are aliases for the same manager-level platform; individual roads and extensions are components, not separate PortCos.

milestones.event: The 395 Express Lanes opened to traffic as part of the Chesapeake managed-lanes platform.
Transurban established the Chesapeake partnership structure around its 495, 95 and 395 Express Lanes assets in connection with the announced 50% institutional partner sale.
CPP Investments announced a 15% Chesapeake interest on December 16 and AustralianSuper announced a 25% interest on December 17; UniSuper agreed to acquire 10% and Transurban would retain 50%.
Transurban completed the sale of a 50% interest in Transurban Chesapeake to AustralianSuper, CPP Investments and UniSuper on March 31, 2021; reporting became effective April 1.
VDOT and Transurban opened the 10-mile 95 Express Lanes Fredericksburg Extension to mainline traffic.
